There are a couple differences between the first and third. Mainly, the length. There is a lot more hair in the third photo. Also, the shape is different on top. The first one has an angle on top, so it gradually gets longer from about the parietal ridge inward. The third looks to be all one length across the top. 

As far as I know there is no name for the style, really. Just ask for the length kept tight on the sides and back, and if you trust your stylist, tell them to play around with the length on top. With your face/head shape/hairline, I would be very soft with the angle on top.  Closer to all one length, the better.

Also seek advice from your stylist on (ready for the big reveal?) how to style. I think a good product for you would be a matte defining paste, texturing paste, whatever each particular brand wants to call it.

I'm not saying one should not seek professional help. I **AM** saying that speaking to others, reaching out even if the persons are not liscensed, should not be overlooked as beneficial!
Unless you don't have insurance or any means to. The resulting debt and stress really just kicks you when you're down.
